name: Dead Letter
summary: A post office 404 page: letters ride a belt under a stamp, and lost addresses land in the dead letter bin
about: A full not-found page set in a busy sorting office. Envelopes ride a conveyor belt under a red stamping press; good addresses fly up into their pigeonholes, while the missing page gets stamped Return to sender and drops into the dead letter bin. Visitors write a new address and post it, and their own letter rides the belt to the right page or comes back with suggestions.
how: The stamp thumps the first letter, the page you wanted, and it rides on into the dead letter bin
Letters keep arriving by themselves; good ones fly into their pigeonhole and the counters flip
Type where you want to go, like pricing, track or jobs, and press Post it to drop your own letter on the belt
Your letter is stamped and delivered to the matching pigeonhole, or returned to sender with three suggestions
Press any pigeonhole to open that page's card, and use the belt speed lever to slow or stop the line
Back to home and Go back sit under the result card, and popular pages show as chips under the address
